Defence modernization and space intelligence dominate federal procurement priorities. 🛰️

### International Trade & Customs Compliance
The Canadian International Trade Tribunal initiated strict SIMA anti-dumping injury inquiries on imported truck and bus tires from China, exposing importers to potential retroactive duties. Importers must conduct deep-tier origin audits and establish customs valuation safeguards ahead of CBSA preliminary determinations due by November 30, 2026. Advisory practices and trade consultants can package anti-dumping defense and SIMA compliance audits for affected commercial tire distributors.

### Border Security & Intelligence
The CBSA and Frontex formalized an enhanced operational cooperation framework to target cross-border identity fraud and transnational smuggling networks. Transnational supply chains face heightened scrutiny regarding document verification gaps, exposing operators to dwell penalties and intensified audits. Advisory practices can package specialized compliance audit programs to assist multinational logistics providers in aligning with bi-lateral intelligence-sharing protocols.

### Commercial Trade & Revenue Management
Building on the CARM client portal processing 99.65% of entries electronically, importers face administrative risks like dwell penalties and AMPs if financial security and accounting declarations are mismanaged. Enterprise supply chain operators must integrate pre-arrival electronic data interchange filings with CARM Release Prior to Payment financial bonding. Trade advisory practices can structure comprehensive CARM compliance audits and RPP bonding integration programs to safeguard commercial importers against sudden duty assessments.

### Digital Assets & Regulatory Compliance
Canada advanced the Stablecoin Act and Retail Payment Activities Regulations framework, setting rigid compliance thresholds for cross-border digital settlement providers. Unverified reserve assets and inadequate redemption risk management expose digital asset operators to severe regulatory intervention. Advisory practices can package comprehensive regulatory readiness and Bank of Canada registration assessments for payment service providers navigating the new framework.

### Federal Procurement & Telecommunications
Federal procurement security protocols restricted access to critical communications management tenders, driving immediate commercial lockout risks for unverified vendors. Supply chain strategists must integrate pre-qualified Supply Arrangement validation checks into bid management workflows to secure continuous pipeline visibility. Advisory practices can package pre-qualification audits for federal Supply Arrangements to assist supply chain vendors in securing uninterrupted portal access.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/trade-compliance/
